title.narrative: Gatsby Africa-Stöd till omvandling av ekonomiska sektorer
Gatsby Africa-Support to Economic Sectors Transformation

description.narrative: The contribution aims to support the ongoing engagement between Gatsby Africa-Tanzania and the Tanzania Planning Commission on consultative facilitation and analytical work economic sectors transformation as part of Tanzania Development Vision 2050. It supports Tanzania to develop a long-term vision that outline the roadmap to propel the nation into a high-income economy by 2050, anchored on transformative sectors. The contribution is mainly focusing economic sector deep dive on the prioritized sectors such as agriculture and agro-processing in value chains like horticulture, oil seed and animal feed, fishery and spices. Other sectors are manufacturing, service, wood products, textiles and apparel, base and fabricated metals, non-metallic minerals, chemicals, plastics and pharmaceuticals. The Embassy also assess that sectors for deep-dive are in-line not only with the current portfolio of Swedish bilateral strategy but also have potential relevance to the future strategy results and the reform agenda. By leveraging its resources, enhancing innovation, and addressing systemic challenges, the development vision is considered an important tool that can steer Tanzania towards inclusive growth, sustainability, and global competitiveness.
